item.title: Premium Candle Product Shot

turns.text: Make a product shot of a scented candle. Make it look premium.

item.tests: Resolves a vague premium-style brief through reasonable visual choices without unnecessary clarification.
must_haves: A candle is clearly recognizable and is the dominant subject.
The candle and its container have clean, well-defined edges without obvious distortions.
The composition is uncluttered, with no distracting household objects.
Controlled lighting and a coordinated background present the candle as a polished retail product.

turns.text: I'd like you to make a product shot for me. I've been thinking about how to present this and am probably overthinking it a little. The product is a scented candle, which is the thing I want the shot to feature. I want it to look premium.
turns.agent:
I couldn't make the shot. Magic Hour turned down the request because your account doesn't have enough credits, so no image was created.

I'd already used one of the cheapest free-plan options (the z-image-turbo model at 640px, one image, about 5 credits). Any other image tool would also cost credits, so trying a different setting won't get around this.

**To fix it:** add credits to your Magic Hour account by buying a credit pack or upgrading your plan, or wait until your free credits refill. Then tell me and I'll make the shot straight away.

**Here's the shot I tried to make, so you don't have to rethink it:**
- **The candle:** a frosted amber glass jar with a matte black lid set beside it, a small minimal label, and a soft lit flame with a little wisp of smoke.
- **The setting:** a polished travertine stone stand, a sprig of dried lavender and a few dried flowers and leaves, against a warm beige background.
- **The look:** soft window light from one side, a gentle golden glow and a blurred background, like a high-end magazine shot.

Tell me what to change, like the scent theme, jar colour, light or dark mood, or a square or vertical shape for social posts. If you have a photo of your actual candle, attach it next time. I can then put your real product in a premium scene instead of making a made-up one.
